source_title: California Halloween store shooting leaves one dead, six injured; suspect on loose
source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: One person was killed and six others injured in a shooting at a Spirit Halloween store inside the Solano Town Center shopping mall in Fairfield, California on Friday night police said. At least three of the injured were in critical condition.The shooting took place at the store, which sells Halloween costumes and decorations, on the eve of the festival, the Associated Press reported.According to the Fairfield Police Department, officers responded to reports of gunfire at around 8:30 pm local time. All seven victims suffered gunshot wounds, including the person who died.The six injured victims were taken to hospitals for treatment, police said.Fairfield Police Chief Dan Marshall told reporters late Friday that officers were searching for a suspect.
